scan_table_check.description:
Flags Business Rules whose Table is Global. The platform loads global Business Rules for every server-side transaction, whether or not they are needed; they are a legacy way to share functions.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Global Business Rules".
scan_table_check.name: SN-BR-004: Global Business Rule
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Move shared functions to a Script Include, which is loaded only when it is used. If the logic must react to records, put the Business Rule on the specific table it concerns.
scan_table_check.short_description: A Business Rule is defined on the Global table.
